[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]That was way harder than I thought it'd be.[XENO:n ]
I'm just about ready to collapse![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Let's take a rest.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]If the monsters in here killed all these[XENO:n ]
traders, we need to be at our best.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I'm wide awake, so I'll take first watch.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Thanks, man. The nap'll do me good.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk. My turn.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT27 ]Awake already?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]Didn't sleep a wink. And I still feel like[XENO:n ]
I just did one of Vangarre's drills![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Heh.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hey... Why do you think the Mechon attacked?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Are we just food to them?[XENO:n ]
Or, what, did we do something wrong?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Sort of reminds me of the battle between[XENO:n ]
the Giant God and the Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I wonder if it's anything to do with that?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Well...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It's hard to believe that living things[XENO:n ]
are just a source of energy for machines.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
There has to be another reason.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]The Mechon killed Fiorung.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Yeah.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You know what? I'll never forgive 'em.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I don't care what their reason is.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Hmm.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

When it happened, the Monado showed me[XENO:n ]
that Fiorung was in danger.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
But I couldn't save her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It's not your fault.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Just 'cos the Monado showed you some future,[XENO:n ]
that don't mean you could do anything about it.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
You did great. You fought them off.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]I couldn't have done that.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I suppose...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You know, I've been thinking about it.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Why you can use the Monado, I mean.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dickson told me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You're a survivor from the Monado expedition[XENO:n ]
team that went out 14 years ago.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

There was a blizzard or something[XENO:n ]
and your mum and dad died.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
And then Dickson found you and brought you back.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT12 ]That sounds right. I was pretty young,[XENO:n ]
so I don't really remember anything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Is that why you do it?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Why you're always helping Dickson with his research[XENO:n ]
and trying to figure out the Monado?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Maybe.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Part of me does see it as something[XENO:n ]
to remind me of my mum and dad.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

But mainly, if it really is the sword that the Giant God[XENO:n ]
used to kill the Machine God, like in the legend...[XENO:wait wait=key ]
I want to work out its secret.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
That's the real reason.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I've got it! You were chosen.[XENO:n ]
By the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What? Chosen?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Don't you see? Not even Dunban can handle it.[XENO:n ]
It ain't chance that you can and he can't.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'll take the next watch.[XENO:n ]
You get some rest.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
OK, I'll try.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Night, Reyn.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
